def laplacien(image: Float[Array, '16 16 3']):
    bprobe_trace = []
    bprobe_v0 = image[1:-1, 1:-1]
    bprobe_trace.append((7, bprobe_v0))
    bprobe_v1 = 4 * bprobe_v0
    bprobe_trace.append((4, bprobe_v1))
    bprobe_v2 = image[0:-2, 1:-1]
    bprobe_trace.append((8, bprobe_v2))
    bprobe_v3 = bprobe_v1 - bprobe_v2
    bprobe_trace.append((5, bprobe_v3))
    bprobe_v4 = image[2:, 1:-1]
    bprobe_trace.append((9, bprobe_v4))
    bprobe_v5 = bprobe_v3 - bprobe_v4
    bprobe_trace.append((6, bprobe_v5))
    bprobe_v6 = image[1:-1, 0:-2]
    bprobe_trace.append((10, bprobe_v6))
    bprobe_v7 = bprobe_v5 - bprobe_v6
    bprobe_trace.append((2, bprobe_v7))
    bprobe_v8 = image[1:-1, 2:]
    bprobe_trace.append((0, bprobe_v8))
    bprobe_v9 = bprobe_v7 - bprobe_v8
    bprobe_trace.append((3, bprobe_v9))
    bprobe_v10 = np.abs(bprobe_v9)
    bprobe_trace.append((1, bprobe_v10))
    out_image = bprobe_v10
    valmax = np.max(out_image)
    valmax = max(1.0, valmax) + 1e-09
    out_image /= valmax
    return bprobe_trace
